acceptedOperations.reason: Define an isolated query command boundary and its JSON-only output behavior.
acceptedOperations.replacement: `sennel flow query` は top-level command として専用 query dispatch path に入り、stdin または `--request-file` のどちらか一方から exactly one JSON object を受ける。同時指定、入力なし、trailing value、multiple value、unknown field、resource 不適合 field を拒否し、query-specific Schema Revision 1 response の JSON だけを stdout に出す。汎用 Flow Envelope、ambient Flow lifecycle、runtime log、post-hook はこの dispatch path では使用しない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Specify exact known-resource error payloads and public-safe error path semantics.
acceptedOperations.replacement: known-resource error は Schema Revision 1、resource、selected Version、unique ascending available Version list、`{ code, path, message }` を持ち、metadata では `item: null`、activities では空 `items` と `{ limit, endCursor, hasNext }` の `pageInfo` を返す。`path` は内部 storage path ではなく次の public request domain のいずれか (`/request`, `/resource`, `/condition/specId`, `/condition/flowVersion`, `/page/limit`, `/page/after`, `/recordedAt/gte`, `/recordedAt/lt`, `/canonical`) とし、message/path に filesystem path、file name、catalog key、lock name を含めない。invalid JSON など resource 不明 error は resource-specific payload を省略する。Canonical reader の parse、permission、missing required record は `CANONICAL_RECORD_UNREADABLE`、identity、digest、schema、contiguous ledger、catalog relation の不一致は `CANONICAL_RECORD_INCONSISTENT` とし、その他の request/spec/version/cursor failures は R13 の対応 code と public path を使う。

acceptedOperations.reason: Make the read-only guarantee explicit for transient locks, logs, and dispatch side effects.
acceptedOperations.replacement: `flow query` は successful/failed の全経路で side-effect-free とする。専用 reader は canonical bytes を read-only open し、lock を取得・materialize せず、canonical file、Version-local `.runtime/locks` / owner file、cache、temporary data、Activity ledger、runtime log、Git working tree を作成・更新・削除しない。acceptance test はこれらの digest、存在、内容、Git status を前後比較し、generic Flow lifecycle と post-hook が呼ばれないことも確認する。

acceptedOperations.reason: Give the query command a dedicated adapter contract independent of ambient Flow behavior.
acceptedOperations.replacement: `flow query` の adapter は stdin/`--request-file` を検証して read-only query service を直接 dispatch し、成功・失敗とも query-specific Schema Revision 1 response の JSON 一つだけを stdout に出し、診断を stderr、`ok: false` を non-zero exit に分離する。generic Flow Envelope、ambient lifecycle、runtime-log、post-hook を通らず、state / ledger / catalog / cache / Git mutation API を呼ばない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Name the production Version discovery authority and distinguish identity from state format revision.
acceptedOperations.replacement: canonical Store から対象 Spec に属する canonical directory/version identity (`FlowVersionLocation`) を列挙する non-migration、read-only `CanonicalFlowVersionReader.listAvailableVersions(specId)` を用い、response と Version-not-found error に unique ascending `availableFlowVersions` を含める。`condition.flowVersion` は directory identity を選び、指定がなければ 1、明示指定が存在しなければ fallback なしで `FLOW_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` とする。state の `version` は別の format revision であり、選択 Version ではない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Require one validated production reader boundary for fresh, migrated, and higher Versions.
acceptedOperations.replacement: fresh / migrated Flow を同じ non-migration `CanonicalFlowVersionReader` に渡し、Version 1 専用 facade を経由せず、Version 2 以降を含む `FlowVersionLocation` の discovery と selected Version の open/validation を行う。state、Spec record、confirmed Activity prefix、Artifact catalog は全 Version で同一の validated reader boundary を通し、query code / schema に Version 1 hardcode、old layout parser、migration report 依存を持たせない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Define the higher-Version reader API, shared validation, and side-effect-free read mode.
acceptedOperations.replacement: `CanonicalFlowVersionReader` は `listAvailableVersions(specId)` で canonical `FlowVersionLocation` を unique ascending に列挙し、`open(specId, flowVersion)` で指定 identity を fallback なしに開く。open は state/spec/confirmed-ledger/catalog の共通 validation boundary を Version 1 以上に適用し、`FlowVersion` の directory identity と state format revision を混同しない。old layout、migration classifier/report、Version 1 専用 `CurrentFlowVersionStore` facade は参照せず、query read mode では lock materialization を含む filesystem mutation を行わない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Fix the metadata success cardinality and selected-Version tree.
acceptedOperations.replacement: Schema Revision 1 の metadata success は exact top-level keys `{ schemaRevision: 1, ok: true, resource: "metadata", selectedFlowVersion: { specId: string, flowVersion: positive safe integer }, availableFlowVersions: unique ascending positive safe integer[], item: MetadataItem }` を返す。`item` は必ず一つで、`items`、request-side `cardinality`、request-side `order`、state format revision を返さない。`flowVersion` と `availableFlowVersions` は canonical directory/version identity を示す。

acceptedOperations.reason: Define the metadata item whitelist and public source boundary.
acceptedOperations.replacement: metadata の `item` は exact public whitelist `{ identity, lifecycle, location, structure, relationships, timestamps, capabilities, artifacts, metrics }` を持つ。`identity` は `{ specId: string, flowVersion: positive safe integer }`、`lifecycle` は `{ status: "active"|"parked"|"finalized", blocked: boolean }`、`location` は public Git availability/commit metadata のみ、`structure`/`relationships` は public node/task IDs のみ、`timestamps` は authority-backed Timestamp values、`artifacts` は ArtifactDescriptor[]、`metrics` は AggregateMetrics とする。internal path、catalog、body、raw state は field whitelist の外に置く。

acceptedOperations.reason: Set event-based timestamp authority and unavailable-value behavior.
acceptedOperations.replacement: `timestamps.created` は confirmed prefix の最初の `transition.operation === "flow_created"` Activity の `timing.finishedAt`、`timestamps.updated` は state を変更した confirmed Activity のうち最新の `timing.finishedAt`、`timestamps.finalized` は最新の `transition.operation === "finalize_flow"` Activity の `timing.finishedAt` から作る。各値は `{ value: ISO8601|string|null, availability: "available"|"unavailable", reason: string|null, provenance: string|null }` とし、証拠がなければ filesystem timestamp/query time を使わず non-empty reason/provenance 付き unavailable にする。

acceptedOperations.reason: Specify the artifact descriptor whitelist and relation-only projection.
acceptedOperations.replacement: public `ArtifactDescriptor` は exact keys `{ artifactId: string, metadata: { logicalKey: string|null, schemaRevision: positive integer|null, mediaType: string|null }, activityIds: string[], nodeIds: string[], taskIds: string[] }` を持つ。`artifactId` は canonical descriptor identity から deterministic に生成し、relation arrays は ID のみを返す。`relativePath`、internal filename、raw catalog、Artifact body、未検証 descriptor field は公開しない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Fix the activities success cardinality and confirmed-prefix ordering contract.
acceptedOperations.replacement: Schema Revision 1 の activities success は exact top-level keys `{ schemaRevision: 1, ok: true, resource: "activities", selectedFlowVersion: SelectedFlowVersion, availableFlowVersions: positive safe integer[], items: ActivityItem[], pageInfo: { limit: integer, endCursor: string|null, hasNext: boolean } }` を返し、`item` を返さない。`items` は validated reader が保持する confirmed prefix のみを `confirmationOrder` 昇順で投影し、request の bounds/filter/cursor はその列を同順で絞る。

acceptedOperations.reason: Define an exact activity item tree and block internal payload leakage.
acceptedOperations.replacement: 各 `ActivityItem` は exact public keys `{ activity: { id: string, type: string }, node: { id: string, key: string }, task: { id: string, key: string }|null, attempt: { id: string, sequence: positive integer }|null, sequence: positive integer|null, confirmationOrder: positive integer, transition: { operation: string, status: string|null }, timing: Timing|null, usage: Usage|null, outcome: Outcome|null, failure: Failure|null, blocker: Blocker|null, incomplete: Incomplete|null, metric: Metric|null, note: string|null, evaluationIds: string[], findingIds: string[], repairIds: string[], artifactIds: string[] }` を持つ。Timing/Usage/Outcome/Failure/Blocker/Incomplete/Metric は canonical typed values の whitelist projection とし、raw logs、prompt、checkpoint、transaction、lock、temporary data、Artifact body、その他の transition payload を返さない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Make the contract owner responsible for exact trees, types, and safety mappings.
acceptedOperations.replacement: Schema Revision 1 の request、resource-specific success/error response、Timestamp、SelectedFlowVersion、MetadataItem、ActivityItem、ArtifactDescriptor、AggregateMetrics、cursor、public-safe error path を centrally managed contract として定義し、metadata / activities の cardinality、exact keys、types、nullability、source mapping、stable error code を固定する。

acceptedOperations.reason: Centralize exact response trees, whitelist mappings, and internal-boundary rules.
acceptedOperations.replacement: 既存 generic Flow Envelope と混同しない query-specific class / schema を設ける。Schema Revision 1 の success top-level trees は metadata `{ schemaRevision: 1, ok: true, resource: "metadata", selectedFlowVersion: SelectedFlowVersion, availableFlowVersions: integer[], item: MetadataItem }` と activities `{ schemaRevision: 1, ok: true, resource: "activities", selectedFlowVersion: SelectedFlowVersion, availableFlowVersions: integer[], items: ActivityItem[], pageInfo: { limit: integer, endCursor: string|null, hasNext: boolean } }` の exact keys とする。`MetadataItem` は `{ identity, lifecycle, location, structure, relationships, timestamps, capabilities, artifacts, metrics }`、`ActivityItem` は R11 の exact whitelist、`ArtifactDescriptor` は R7 の exact whitelist、Timestamp は `{ value: ISO8601|null, availability, reason, provenance }` とし、cost は provider が amount と currency を実測した場合だけ公開する。identity/selection は FlowVersion/FlowSpecIdentity、state/lifecycle/blocked は validated CurrentFlowState、timestamps は confirmed Activity timing、activities は confirmed prefix、metrics は ActivityUsage/ActivityMetric、artifacts は validated catalog descriptor/association から写像する。error の `path` は public request domain のみとし、内部 path/name/body/raw catalog を success/error のどこにも含めない。

acceptedOperations.reason: Map every required reader failure to a stable code and safe public path.
acceptedOperations.replacement: error code は centrally managed enum とし、`INVALID_JSON`→`/request`、`INVALID_REQUEST`→request field、`SPEC_NOT_FOUND`→`/condition/specId`、`FLOW_VERSION_NOT_FOUND`→`/condition/flowVersion`、`CANONICAL_RECORD_UNREADABLE`→`/canonical`、`CANONICAL_RECORD_INCONSISTENT`→`/canonical`、`INVALID_CURSOR`→`/page/after`、`CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH`→`/page/after` に固定する。parse/read/permission failures は UNREADABLE、identity/digest/schema/ledger/catalog integrity failures は INCONSISTENT に分類し、message/path は内部 storage path/name を redaction する。`ok: false` では CLI を non-zero で終了する。

acceptedOperations.reason: Define event selection, delta/reset handling, aggregation precedence, and measured-only cost.
acceptedOperations.replacement: confirmed Activity prefix を confirmationOrder 昇順に一度だけ走査する。created は最初の `flow_created`、updated は state-changing transition の最新、finalized は `finalize_flow` の最新の `timing.finishedAt` を使い、該当なしは non-empty reason/provenance 付き unavailable とする。AggregateMetrics は `{ activityCount: non-negative integer, durationMs: non-negative integer, inputTokens: non-negative integer, outputTokens: non-negative integer, cacheReadTokens: non-negative integer, cost: { amount: non-negative number, currency: string }|null }` とし、duration/usage は non-null measured values のみ加算、counter metric は reset 後の delta を一度だけ加算し、usage と同じ観測を metric で二重計上しない。cost は amount/currency が同一 provider measurement に存在する場合だけ採用し、token/model/time から推計しない。

findings.body:
**Target:** R1, R12, R16, T7, Query command adapter
**Issue:** The existing Flow registry and dispatcher route commands through the generic Flow Envelope, while `flow.js` has no `query` group. Generic failures also invoke runtime logging and may record lifecycle/tooling failures.
**Required change:** Specify that `flow query` uses a dedicated dispatch path that accepts the top-level command, emits the query schema for both success and error, and bypasses ambient Flow lifecycle, runtime-log, and post-hook behavior.
**Why blocking:** Without this boundary, the command is either unroutable, emits the wrong top-level JSON shape, or can mutate Flow state/logs on failed or active-Flow queries.
findings.evidence: The review identifies a concrete contract gap in R1, R12, R16, and T7: the specification does not require a query-specific dispatch boundary that emits only the query schema and bypasses ambient lifecycle, runtime-log, and post-hook behavior.
findings.issue: The existing Flow registry and dispatcher route commands through the generic Flow Envelope, while `flow.js` has no `query` group. Generic failures also invoke runtime logging and may record lifecycle/tooling failures.
findings.requiredChange: Specify that `flow query` uses a dedicated dispatch path that accepts the top-level command, emits the query schema for both success and error, and bypasses ambient Flow lifecycle, runtime-log, and post-hook behavior.
findings.target: R1, R12, R16, T7, Query command adapter
findings.title: Query-specific output has no isolated dispatch target
findings.whyBlocking: Without this boundary, the command is either unroutable, emits the wrong top-level JSON shape, or can mutate Flow state/logs on failed or active-Flow queries.

findings.body:
**Target:** R3, R15, T3, Canonical Version discovery / reader
**Issue:** `CanonicalFlowRuntime`, `CanonicalFlowManagerStore`, and `CurrentFlowVersionStore` resolve or validate Version 1 only. The generic `FlowVersion` value object supports higher versions, but the only higher-version validation path is migration-oriented and production runtime APIs reject it.
**Required change:** Name the non-migration, read-only canonical API that enumerates available `FlowVersionLocation` entries and opens and validates the selected version, including the shared state/spec/catalog validation boundary for versions above 1.
**Why blocking:** The required Version 2+ fixtures cannot be implemented through the existing authority APIs, and the spec forbids solving the gap with migration parsers or Version 1 fallback.
findings.evidence: The review confirms that Version 2+ discovery has no named non-migration read-only authority: the existing runtime and state store are Version 1-only, so R3, R15, and T3 must specify enumeration and validated opening for every canonical Flow Version.
findings.issue: `CanonicalFlowRuntime`, `CanonicalFlowManagerStore`, and `CurrentFlowVersionStore` resolve or validate Version 1 only. The generic `FlowVersion` value object supports higher versions, but the only higher-version validation path is migration-oriented and production runtime APIs reject it.
findings.requiredChange: Name the non-migration, read-only canonical API that enumerates available `FlowVersionLocation` entries and opens and validates the selected version, including the shared state/spec/catalog validation boundary for versions above 1.
findings.target: R3, R15, T3, Canonical Version discovery / reader
findings.title: Version 2+ discovery has no production reader authority
findings.whyBlocking: The required Version 2+ fixtures cannot be implemented through the existing authority APIs, and the spec forbids solving the gap with migration parsers or Version 1 fallback.

findings.body:
**Target:** R4-R8, R11-R12, T1, T4, T5, T9
**Issue:** The requirements name field groups but do not define exact JSON trees, types, nullability, enums, or source mappings. Existing `FlowActivity` data contains nested transition fields and internal structures, while task, blocker, incomplete, evaluation, finding, repair, and artifact relations are not uniformly top-level fields.
**Required change:** Define the exact Schema Revision 1 field trees and an explicit whitelist/source mapping for selected versions, metadata, activities, artifact descriptors, timestamps, relations, and error payloads.
**Why blocking:** Different implementations can produce materially different responses or leak nested internal fields, so consumer compatibility and exact contract tests cannot be designed from the current specification.
findings.evidence: The review shows that R4-R8, R11-R12, and T1/T4/T5/T9 name field groups without exact JSON trees, nullability, enums, or source mappings; this leaves both consumer compatibility and internal-field exclusion materially underspecified.
findings.issue: The requirements name field groups but do not define exact JSON trees, types, nullability, enums, or source mappings. Existing `FlowActivity` data contains nested transition fields and internal structures, while task, blocker, incomplete, evaluation, finding, repair, and artifact relations are not uniformly top-level fields.
findings.requiredChange: Define the exact Schema Revision 1 field trees and an explicit whitelist/source mapping for selected versions, metadata, activities, artifact descriptors, timestamps, relations, and error payloads.
findings.title: Public projection fields and source mappings are not defined
findings.whyBlocking: Different implementations can produce materially different responses or leak nested internal fields, so consumer compatibility and exact contract tests cannot be designed from the current specification.

findings.body:
**Target:** R5, R6, T4, metadata acceptance
**Issue:** The current state model has no direct `updatedAt` or `finalizedAt` fields; lifecycle evidence is distributed across Activities. `ActivityUsage` and `ActivityMetric` expose overlapping token, cost, and duration data with deltas, resets, and nullable measurements, but the spec does not define aggregation scope or precedence.
**Required change:** Specify the Activity/event authority and selection rule for creation, update, and finalization timestamps, plus exact aggregate metric fields, reset/delta handling, usage-versus-metric precedence, missing-value behavior, and measured-cost rules.
**Why blocking:** Tests cannot determine expected metadata values, and an implementation may incorrectly use filesystem times, double-count observations, or invent aggregate values.
findings.evidence: The review confirms that updated/finalized timestamps and aggregate metrics lack a defined Activity authority, event-selection rule, reset/delta handling, precedence, and missing-value behavior in R5, R6, and T4.
findings.issue: The current state model has no direct `updatedAt` or `finalizedAt` fields; lifecycle evidence is distributed across Activities. `ActivityUsage` and `ActivityMetric` expose overlapping token, cost, and duration data with deltas, resets, and nullable measurements, but the spec does not define aggregation scope or precedence.
findings.requiredChange: Specify the Activity/event authority and selection rule for creation, update, and finalization timestamps, plus exact aggregate metric fields, reset/delta handling, usage-versus-metric precedence, missing-value behavior, and measured-cost rules.
findings.title: Timestamp and aggregate-metric authority is incomplete
findings.whyBlocking: Tests cannot determine expected metadata values, and an implementation may incorrectly use filesystem times, double-count observations, or invent aggregate values.

findings.body:
**Target:** R12, R13, Response / error contract
**Issue:** Existing canonical readers and generic error handling can include paths such as `flow.json`, `artifact-catalog.json`, or filesystem locations in error messages. The spec requires a `path` field but does not say whether it is a public request path or an internal storage path, nor does it map reader, parse, integrity, and lock failures to the listed stable codes.
**Required change:** Define `path` as a public-safe path domain, require redaction of internal paths from messages, and provide the mapping from each mandatory canonical-reader failure class to the allowed error codes.
**Why blocking:** A conforming implementation could leak forbidden storage details or return unmappable errors, making the safety and machine-readable error contract impossible to verify.
findings.evidence: The review identifies an unresolved safety and mapping gap: R12/R13 require a public path field but do not define its safe domain or map parse, integrity, reader, and lock failures to the stable error codes without exposing internal storage paths.
findings.issue: Existing canonical readers and generic error handling can include paths such as `flow.json`, `artifact-catalog.json`, or filesystem locations in error messages. The spec requires a `path` field but does not say whether it is a public request path or an internal storage path, nor does it map reader, parse, integrity, and lock failures to the listed stable codes.
findings.requiredChange: Define `path` as a public-safe path domain, require redaction of internal paths from messages, and provide the mapping from each mandatory canonical-reader failure class to the allowed error codes.
findings.title: Error path semantics conflict with internal-path exclusion
findings.whyBlocking: A conforming implementation could leak forbidden storage details or return unmappable errors, making the safety and machine-readable error contract impossible to verify.

findings.body:
**Target:** R16, Canonical Version discovery / reader
**Issue:** `CurrentFlowStateStore` and `FlowArtifactCatalogStore` acquire locks by creating or updating Version-local `.runtime/locks` and owner files, even during reads. These are transient rather than canonical artifacts, but they are filesystem mutations.
**Required change:** State whether transient lock materialization is permitted by R16; if it is not, require a query-specific side-effect-free consistency/read strategy and include that storage in the before/after verification scope.
**Why blocking:** The current reader path can change the Version directory during a query, so the claimed read-only guarantee and its acceptance test have no implementable behavior until this boundary is decided.
findings.evidence: The review demonstrates that the current state and artifact readers materialize Version-local lock files during reads, which conflicts with R16's strict read-only contract unless a side-effect-free query read strategy and verification scope are specified.
findings.issue: `CurrentFlowStateStore` and `FlowArtifactCatalogStore` acquire locks by creating or updating Version-local `.runtime/locks` and owner files, even during reads. These are transient rather than canonical artifacts, but they are filesystem mutations.
findings.requiredChange: State whether transient lock materialization is permitted by R16; if it is not, require a query-specific side-effect-free consistency/read strategy and include that storage in the before/after verification scope.
findings.title: Strict read-only behavior is incompatible with existing read paths unless scoped
findings.whyBlocking: The current reader path can change the Version directory during a query, so the claimed read-only guarantee and its acceptance test have no implementable behavior until this boundary is decided.

findings.body:
**Target:** R2-R4, selectedFlowVersion
**Improvement:** State explicitly that `condition.flowVersion` and `availableFlowVersions` refer to the canonical directory/version identity, while the existing state `version` field is a separate format revision.
**Why non-blocking:** The existing value objects provide enough information to make the distinction during implementation; the clarification mainly prevents naming confusion.
findings.evidence: The improvement is valid and bounded: R2-R4 use Flow Version identity for canonical directory selection while the state version is a separate format revision, so the distinction should be stated explicitly for consumers and implementers.
findings.improvement: State explicitly that `condition.flowVersion` and `availableFlowVersions` refer to the canonical directory/version identity, while the existing state `version` field is a separate format revision.
findings.title: Distinguish Flow Version identity from state format revision
findings.whyNonBlocking: The existing value objects provide enough information to make the distinction during implementation; the clarification mainly prevents naming confusion.
